properties.name: Every relation tool accepts the other family's names for its ends, and the kit states the one convention
properties.rationale: dev_storyflow's fleet lost five calls in one workflow to spellings, and diagnosed it themselves: locally sensible, globally inconsistent. Aliases forgive the other family's name without growing the taught surface — the precedent was ContributorReq.id taking contributor_id. Two choices on the record: (1) node_id/node_type accepted for the from end, because the sharpest reported form was search_design handing back a key the next tool refused; (2) the shared pair struct split rather than aliased in place, because component_id is the from end of provides and the to end of allocate, and one struct cannot alias both ways. Option D (get_node's either/or message) is separable and still open.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Item 4 of v0.50.0. Serde aliases on 30 relation request structs: from_*/to_* on the role-named tools, role names on the from/to tools, node_id/node_type for the from end everywhere; the shared EdgePairReq split into seven per-tool structs so each carries its own role names; the seven handlers and twelve test literals moved to them. The kit's AGENTS.md Tools section states the convention once. Published schema unchanged (toolsnap goldens byte-identical). Five table-shaped tests plus the fleet's handoff end to end.
